findings.summary: A CFAResidual identity is constructed during solving, contrary to FR-021 and C-10.
findings.evidence: activate is called by synchronous watchers from update, including during solve (lib/arch_index/arch_index_cfa.ml:76-103,144-151), and constructs {target; consumed = total} at lib/arch_index/arch_index_cfa_cmt.ml:511-514; value_of_call exposes that identity at lines 594-598.
findings.fix: Preallocate the finite residual table before solve and select only an existing entry during activation.

findings.summary: Recursive-group admission accepts unsupported Texp_function members.
findings.evidence: The allocator admits callables only for Tfunction_body at lib/arch_index/arch_index_cfa_cmt.ml:182-187, but group_supported accepts every Texp_function at lines 218-227 and enrolls roots at lines 233-250; lib/arch_index/arch_index_cmt.ml:2101-2110 and 2178-2185 repeat the broad predicate.
findings.fix: Use one predicate requiring Tfunction_body and fully supported formals for every member, and add an authentic mixed-group refusal fixture.

findings.summary: Synchronous watcher notification makes native stack depth proportional to application and residual chains.
findings.evidence: update directly invokes watchers at lib/arch_index/arch_index_cfa.ml:86-103, registrations replay values at lines 122-135, and register_application connects them to activate at lib/arch_index/arch_index_cfa_cmt.ml:487-520.
findings.fix: Queue finite target, reason, and residual events and drain them iteratively with the worklist.

findings.summary: Local mutually recursive groups are registered only after their bodies are analyzed.
findings.evidence: lib/arch_index/arch_index_cmt.ml:2112-2143 walks each recursive binding body before lines 2178-2184 register that binder; a first member referring to a later peer is looked up by lib/arch_index/arch_index_cfa_cmt.ml:371-375 before the peer has an owner/cell and becomes Callback_param.
findings.fix: Pre-register every supported local recursive binder before walking any RHS, then collect bodies and constraints; add an authentic local mutual-recursion fixture.

findings.summary: A call through a physical application result discards its CFA occurrence token.
findings.evidence: lib/arch_index/arch_index_cmt.ml:2534-2540 registers every Texp_apply, but record_head attaches the token only to unresolved identifiers and if/match/sequence heads at lines 2579-2630; a Texp_apply head reaches lines 2642-2645 and remains MAY_TOP.
findings.fix: Route Texp_apply heads through the CFA-marker branch and add an authentic direct staged call such as (identity target) x.

findings.summary: Overapplication flows an unconsumed raw return into the whole application result.
findings.evidence: lib/arch_index/arch_index_cfa_cmt.ml:500 accepts empty remaining formals even when actuals remain, then lines 511-514 copy callable.result to the physical whole-application result.
findings.fix: Distinguish exact saturation from remaining actuals; keep the residual occurrence but make the whole result callback-open without copying the raw return, and test a downstream invocation.

findings.summary: CHECK-2 misclassifies Stage-3 assertion failures as setup failures.
findings.evidence: The wrapper delegates to roster/ocaml-cfa-foundation/check-cmt.js, whose assertion whitelist omits the OCAML_CFA_PROPAGATION, RECURSION and CAPTURE prefixes used at tezt/tests/ocaml_cfa_foundation.ml:507-584.
findings.fix: Add a Stage-3-aware classifier and controlled 0/1/2 exit-contract self-tests for each new marker family.

findings.summary: Supported simple-let application heads discard their CFA occurrence token and remain TOP.
findings.evidence: register_application creates a token and expression_cell supports Texp_let (Nonrecursive,[binding],body), but record_head attaches cfa_application_token only for Texp_ifthenelse, Texp_match, Texp_sequence, and Texp_apply at lines 2640-2645. A supported call such as (let f = target in f) x therefore falls through lines 2657-2660 to Head_unknown; expand_cfa_calls never reads its resolved token, so the physical call misses target despite the shared dispatcher resolving it.
findings.fix: Route supported Texp_let heads through the CFA-marker branch (unsupported let shapes already become callback uncertainty in expression_cell) and add authentic main/flat coverage for a saturated simple-let head, including exact occurrence metadata and retained frontier controls.
